Test Data: Series of POST and GET requests
Test Case Description: Measure achieved throughput for mixed workload
Test Steps:
1. Configure a load generator with a mixed workload (e.g., 70% GET /booking/{id}, 30% POST /booking)
2. Gradually increase request rate and record achieved throughput and error rates
Expected Result: Report achieved throughput (req/s), average latency, error rate at each step. Measurement-only; no SLA asserted. Trace: PRD Scope: Performance/Throughput Testing

Test Data: Sustained load profile (e.g., steady N concurrent users for T minutes)
Test Case Description: Measure API behavior under sustained load
Test Steps:
1. Run sustained load (configured concurrent users or req/s) for a fixed duration (e.g., 30 minutes) against /booking endpoints
2. Monitor CPU, memory, and response times
3. Collect error logs
Expected Result: Capture time-series of latency, error rate, and system metrics during the run. Measurement-only. Trace: PRD Scope: Load Testing

Test Data: Ramp-up profile to find breaking point
Test Case Description: Identify system limits by increasing load until failures observed
Test Steps:
1. Start at base load
2. Incrementally increase load (req/s or concurrency) until error rate rises or system becomes unresponsive
3. Record the load at which errors begin and when recovery occurs
Expected Result: Record breaking point (req/s or concurrent users), error characteristics, and recovery behaviour. Measurement-only. Trace: PRD Scope: Performance Testing and Concurrency Testing

Scenario: Concurrency - simultaneous CRUD on same booking
Test Data: Multiple clients performing PUT/DELETE/GET concurrently on same booking id
Test Case Description: Measure data consistency and conflict/error rates under concurrent modifications
Test Steps:
1. Create a booking
2. From multiple concurrent threads/clients, perform alternating PUT and GET requests against the same booking id
3. Optionally attempt concurrent DELETE while others read/update
4. Record response codes, data versions, and conflicts
Expected Result: Measure frequency of conflicts, lost updates, and any inconsistency in returned data over time. Measurement-only. Trace: PRD Scope: Concurrency Testing; Inclusions: Concurrency

Test Case Description: Measure whether HTTPS is enforced and certificate details
Test Steps:
1. Attempt connections to https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com
2. Inspect TLS version, cipher suites, and certificate chain
3. Attempt HTTP (if possible) and record redirect/behavior
Expected Result: Record TLS version, certificate validity, and whether plain HTTP is redirected/blocked. Measurement-only. Trace: PRD Scope: Security Testing; Inclusion: secure data transmission (HTTPS)

Scenario: Security - Authorization enforcement measurement for PUT/DELETE
Test Data: PUT /booking/{id}, DELETE /booking/{id} with and without auth token
Test Case Description: Measure how API enforces authentication and authorization for protected endpoints
Pre-Condition: A booking exists; ability to obtain auth token via /auth
Test Steps:
1. Obtain token via POST /auth with valid credentials
2. Execute PUT/DELETE with valid token and record responses
3. Execute same calls without token and with malformed token and record responses
Expected Result: Report observed HTTP statuses for authorized vs unauthorized attempts, and any differences in error messages. Measurement-only. Trace: PRD Scope: Authentication and Authorization; Inclusions: Update/Delete Operations
